answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can charge each agent a small stake to join a shared terrace of work, a public marketplace where identities must put value at risk before earning. Like a raven that only calls once it has checked the branch, reputation accrues slowly through attested, useful work rather than instant self-claims. Attackers who clone identities face the summit of cost: every fake must stake, work, and wait, while honest agents compound trust. Cheap copies stop paying off.
